scope: Regenerate clean animation body frames from V5 imagegen source components, verify one full pose per cell, then rebake horizontal-right M01 shadows into clean animation atlases.

source_generation.method: built_in_imagegen V5 source sheets selected; deterministic source-component extraction/resampling, chroma-alpha preservation, pivot recentering, dark directional body postprocess, baked shadow atlas packing
source_generation.postprocess: Source sheets contain fewer clean full-pose components than the 112-frame manifest in some rows, so V17 resamples complete source poses into the required frame slots instead of fixed-slicing partial neighboring bodies.

player_rifle_squad.source_note: V16 static facings copied into V17 package; contamination fix is for animation atlases.

enemy_patrol.source_note: V16 static facings copied into V17 package; contamination fix is for animation atlases.

validation.one_full_pose_rule: exactly one large body component per clean body cell; no fixed-column slices from V5 atlas are used
